method: public long hardwoodColumnar() throws IOException { long checksum = 0; try (HardwoodContext context = BenchContext.create(); ParquetFileReader reader = ParquetFileReader.openAll(inputFiles, context); ColumnReaders cols = reader.buildColumnReaders(ColumnProjection.columns(COLUMNS)).build()) { ColumnReader passengerCount = cols.getColumnReader(0); ColumnReader tripDistance = cols.getColumnReader(1); ColumnReader fareAmount = cols.getColumnReader(2); while (cols.nextBatch()) { int n = cols.getRecordCount(); long[] passengers = passengerCount.getLongs(); double[] distances = tripDistance.getDoubles(); double[] fares = fareAmount.getDoubles(); for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { checksum += passengers[i] + Double.doubleToLongBits(distances[i]) + Double.doubleToLongBits(fares[i]); } } } return checksum; }
